title: Tests: PBKDF2 vectors from RFC 6070
description: Write kernel test module and userspace test exercising PBKDF2 via CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_DO_KDF. Use test vectors from RFC 6070 (at minimum Test Cases 1, 2, 5 — covers short password, long password, large iteration count with SHA-1 PRF). For SHA-256 PBKDF2 vectors, use NIST SP 800-132 Appendix B if available. Hardcode as static const u8[] arrays. Test: open /dev/crypto2dev, write() password, call DO_KDF ioctl with algo='pbkdf2(sha1)' or 'pbkdf2(sha256)', export resulting KEY fd (exportable=1) and compare against expected DK. Verify iterations < 1000 is rejected with -EINVAL. Depends on framework (WOLFKM-6zx) and wolfssl PBKDF2 (wolfssl-pbkdf2 issue) being complete.
